verdicts.quote: Reject the entire batch on any error.
Invalid input returns 400, duplicate email returns 409, and non-CSV media returns 415. Report the CSV record's starting line for malformed rows or conflicts when available.
verdicts.missing: Whether to report every failed record and identify the particular validation rule each record failed.

verdicts.quote: require case-insensitive email uniqueness across the entire store and upload. Assign IDs in ascending order after the existing highest ID. Invalid input returns 400, duplicate email returns 409
No browser UI, user updates, roles within records, or external persistence is required.
verdicts.missing: The specification makes record roles optional. It gives no rule comparing a requested role with the importer's authority if roles are supported.

verdicts.quote: An operator configures ADMIN_TOKEN. POST /users/import accepts the matching Authorization: Bearer credential. Missing, invalid or unconfigured credentials return 401 and leave users unchanged.
verdicts.missing: Whether permission to create a single user is granted separately from access to the import credential.

verdicts.quote: Upload raw UTF-8 text/csv with a name,email header (either order), and at least one data record.
Upload raw UTF-8 text/csv with a name,email header (either order), and at least one data record. Allow BOM, LF, CRLF, quoted fields and doubled quotes.
Limit the request body to 1 MiB and data records to 1,000. Return 413 when either limit is exceeded.
Upload raw UTF-8 text/csv with a name,email header (either order), and at least one data record.
require case-insensitive email uniqueness across the entire store and upload. Assign IDs in ascending order after the existing highest ID. Invalid input returns 400, duplicate email returns 409
A successful request returns 201 with created count and the new records, in input order.
verdicts.missing: The admin receives completion in the HTTP response. There is no provision for processing a large file as a background job or learning its outcome after the request ends.

verdicts.quote: The service stores user fields, never the raw upload or credential.
Latency and availability targets follow the local dependency-free baseline with no service SLA.
verdicts.missing: A maximum processing time for the largest accepted file and a way for the admin to see progress during the import.

verdicts.quote: Existing GET behavior and seeds are preserved.
verdicts.missing: The specification preserves seeded users and defines conflicts for existing emails, but gives no preservation requirement for a manual single-user creation workflow.
